description:
Detailed Description: 
 · Architect the integration between Marketing Cloud and Salesforce 
 · Lead brand new / existing implementation of Salesforce Marketing Cloud 
 · Help create and validate technical design and solutions based upon client requirements 
 · Document solutions in a clear and articulate manner 
 · Act as SME (Subject Matter Expert) on Salesforce Marketing Cloud and provide technical expertise 
 · Liaise between product teams in order to provide technical support 
 · Carry out solutions testing and validation post-deployment 
 REQUIREMENTS: 
 •Minimum 8 years of IT experience. At least 2 years of Marketing Cloud experience and 5 Years of Salesforce experience 
 • Must have previously implemented Salesforce Marketing Cloud/ExactTarget from scratch 
 •Proficient in API's-SOAP and REST-based, Salesforce 
 •Should be able to code in SQL 
 •Proficient with email templates, drip campaigns, and other components of marketing automation 
 •Journey Builder experience highly required 
 •Proficient in web services and development languages, e.g. HTML, CSS, AJAX, JQuery, HTTP, etc. 
 •Must have excellent communication skills, verbal and written. Interpersonal skills are required 
 •MS Visio experience preferred 


 •Minimum 8 years of IT experience. At least 2 years of   Marketing Cloud experience   and 5 Years of   Salesforce experience
years_evidence: At least 2 years of Marketing Cloud experience and 5 Years of Salesforce experience
